title: Fix: the streak never grows
hints: Trace `longest_streak([True, True, False])` by hand and write down `current` and `best` after every pass through the loop.
`current` is meant to remember the streak **across** days, but it's set back to `0` at the start of every pass, so it can never get past 1.
Move `current = 0` out of the loop, next to `best = 0`, so it's set once before the loop starts.
